chunks: From him, from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Muhammad ibn Muslim and Zurarah, who said: We heard him say:
"The installments (or periodic payments) of the workers are not objectionable."

key_terms.لَيْسَ بِهَا بَأْسٌ: There is no objection to it / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pay workers in installments according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated through the chain of prominent Kufan scholars like Ibn Abi Umayr and Jamil ibn Darraj, clarifies that paying workers in installments (jawā'iz) is legally permissible, addressing practical concerns regarding liquidity and fairness in labor contracts. It reflects the Shia juristic principle that as long as the agreed-upon wages are fulfilled, the method of disbursement does not invalidate the transaction, provided no explicit contractual condition is violated.
